title: One Open Home Delivery Pharmacy Account per Member
content:
## Clause: one open account per member

**Rule.** A member holds at most one Home Delivery Pharmacy account that is not closed; family members each hold their own. A new account may be registered only when the member has no account that is registered, active or on hold.

The limit is one open account per member, and it is read from the company's own account records for that member, not from what the caller says about other accounts.

### Condition, judgement and result

| Member's existing home delivery accounts (system record) | May a new account be registered for this member? |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| Only closed accounts | Yes |
| One account that is registered | No |
| One account that is active | No |
| One account that is on hold | No |

### Points of judgement

- **Whose accounts count?** Only accounts held by the same member. A spouse or a dependent holds an account of their own, so a family member's open account does not stand in the way of this member's registration.
- **Which states block?** Registered, active and on hold. A closed account blocks nothing, so a member whose earlier account was closed may be registered again.
- **What is the limit?** 1 open account per member at any time.

### Hypothetical cases

1. A member's only earlier Home Delivery Pharmacy account shows as closed. A new account may be registered.
2. A member's account shows as on hold for an unpaid balance. No second account is registered while that account is open.
